name: Product
definition: Item that is offered for sale. Products can be services or goods.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Information about the goods and/or services of a trade transaction.

CardPayment.name: Card Payment
CardPayment.definition: Card payment for which a product was specified.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Specifies the line item in which the product is specified.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.definition: Country from which the product originates.

NetPrice.name: Net Price
NetPrice.definition: Net price of the goods and/or service.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies the quantity of the product.

GrossPrice.name: Gross Price
GrossPrice.definition: Gross price of the goods and/or service.

PurchaseOrder.name: Purchase Order
PurchaseOrder.definition: Specifies the purchase order in which a specific product is ordered.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters linked to the value of the goods and services in a trade transaction.
